note: RTT-102 assistant logos (IQ-19, design round 1). Purpose: identification of each assistant on its bar only (house style section 7, as RTT-001 DEC-180/DEC-182 and RTT-103). Files live ONLY in the private repo (assets/rtt-102/logos/), fetched on a GitHub runner by .github/workflows/rtt102_assets.yml with scripts/rtt102_fetch_logos.py, because Wikimedia answers HTTP 429 to the Claude Code container. For each entry the runner keeps up to `keep` candidate files (the named candidates first, then Commons search hits and the logo images on the assistant's English Wikipedia article), records page, licence, author, restrictions and SHA-1 from the wiki API, and keeps a file only if the downloaded SHA-1 equals the API's. Claude then looks at every kept file and names the one each bar uses in config_rtt102_base.json; hashes go into assets_sha256.txt and the rights ledger. Never redrawn or recoloured; crops only where Luke allows. `bard` is the Bard logo of the time (option h), `gemini` today's Gemini logo.
